punchline: Two IBM speech researchers threw away Renaissance's letter, then took the job.
thirty_sec: In 1993 Renaissance sent recruitment letters to IBM speech-recognition researchers Robert Mercer and Peter Brown. They threw them out at first, then left IBM for about 50 percent more pay, and later co-led the firm after Simons retired in 2010.
question: What kind of problem is your team stuck on, and who outside your own field has already spent years on its cousin?
key_contrast: Simons hired people who solved the same kind of problem in another field.
